historical_reviews.deepseek: Cannot establish independent OCP coverage or end-to-end poison handling.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Improves physical safety but tool output and generic device recovery do not prove which OCP service transaction consumed poison.
historical_reviews.related_cases: PCIe row 67 uses identical commands; OCP row 58 uses einjbiopcie errortype 6 at endpoint/root port. This row needs distinct module/interface coverage and command-family authority.
historical_reviews.v3_1: OCP poison validation needs independent management, service dependency mapping and an isolated disposable consumer per direction.

original_test_intent: Verify Poisoned-TLP handling in transmit and receive directions for every required OCP slot, showing an approved disposable OCP traffic transaction carries and consumes poison while the expected AER response contains the event and the interface and dependent services recover.
original_method: Inventory each OCP module, firmware, driver, interface, service dependency and NBIO/core/port path; prove pcieerror 6/7 direction/severity; secure independent OOB management; define requester/completer roles and disposable checksum-protected traffic; baseline AER/link/interface/service state; run TX once and recover fully, then RX once; correlate poison source and consumer outcome; verify no persistent data, link or service impact and restore all state.
manual_activity: The FAE maps and isolates each OCP module/service path, approves flag semantics and disposable consumer traffic, runs TX and RX separately and owns interface, driver and platform recovery.
required_inputs: OCP slot/module serial/FW/driver/interface/BDF to socket/die/NBIO/core/port map and distinct scope versus row 67
Management, storage, fabric and cluster-service dependencies plus independent OOB recovery path
Vendor proof pcieerror errortype 6/7 means Poisoned-TLP TX/RX and relation to einjbiopcie errortype 6
Disposable requester/completer traffic that actually carries/consumes poison with packet/I/O/checksum oracle
Exact AER source/status/severity and interface/service outcome per direction; correctable/nonfatal decision
Decoded 7EF6030/masks/DPC/SyncFlood, supported OS, timeout, aborts, RDIMM relevance and restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated OCP path with independent OOB management and no production, persistent-storage or cluster-control traffic
Verify physical module and live tuple; never reuse row-67 tuple as proof
Use disposable checksum-protected traffic and restore known-good interface/service state between directions
Abort on wrong source, corruption outside disposable data, service loss, driver reset, link loss or fatal/DPC/SyncFlood escalation
No automatic retry; preserve evidence and restore/diff BIOS/HDT/AER/SyncFlood and module state
agent_execution_scope: Validate OCP identity/dependencies, flag semantics, traffic isolation, AER/consumer oracle and recovery
Collect read-only PCIe/AER, link/interface/service, packet/I/O/checksum, OS/BMC and post-health evidence
Do not install hardware, choose tuple/transaction/outcome, change BIOS/HDT, inject/reset/rebind/retry/recover or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve OCP mapping, distinct coverage and direction/severity semantics
Approve disposable consumer and service-impact matrix
Supervise separate TX/RX stimuli and recovery

command_applicability.command_recommendation: After module/dependency and flag approval, run separate TX/RX poison cases on disposable OCP traffic and correlate exact AER source with checksum, interface and service recovery.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Tuple 0:0:1/core3/port0, errortype 6/7, correctable Criteria, OCP slot 1~N, severity/SyncFlood settings and 30/60-minute values remain preserved but gated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Exercise separate topology-mapped TX/RX poison cases using disposable OCP traffic, proving direction-specific AER, bounded consumer impact and restored services.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds module/service identity, independent management, command-family authority, actual consumer traffic, per-direction integrity evidence and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The PCIe companion's tuple plus generic logs cannot prove OCP slot coverage or service preservation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Poison may corrupt or abort network/storage/fabric I/O, remove management connectivity, reset the OCP driver/device or destabilize the host.

project_override_considerations: If an OCP module carries the only management or persistent-storage path, retain execution as pending until an independent channel and disposable consumer exist. Identical commands do not establish distinct OCP coverage.
expected_evidence: Exact OCP module/interface/service and BDF/NBIO identity
Approved command direction/severity mapping and decoded AER policy
Disposable traffic roles, buffer/packet identity and integrity baseline
Separate TX/RX transcripts with exact AER source/status/severity
Consumer outcome and restored link/interface/service health without persistent data impact
Restored configuration and engineer verdict per direction

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: OCP slot 1~N uses the same single tuple as PCIe row 67 with no module/interface/service mapping or distinct coverage. pcieerror 6/7 direction/severity lacks authority, no transaction consumes poison, Criteria call it correctable without an oracle, and 7EF6030, timeout, RHEL 2022 and RDIMM relevance are unresolved.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The directional OCP Poisoned-TLP intent is identifiable. Static review completes while engineering supplies safe consumer traffic and execution authority.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 68 Wistron-System RAS-00788-V002: provide OCP module/interface/service-to-NBIO/core/port coverage and distinct scope versus PCIe row 67; prove pcieerror errortype 6/7 TX/RX semantics and relation to einjbiopcie 6; decide correctable/nonfatal severity; define independent OOB path, isolated poison-consuming traffic and exact AER/process/packet/I/O/checksum plus service outcomes; approve 7EF6030/masks/DPC/SyncFlood, OS, timeout, aborts, RDIMM relevance and restoration.

review_improvement: Makes the OCP variant independently traceable and introduces dependency-isolated consumer traffic plus interface/service evidence instead of reusing PCIe commands and generic logs.
independent_technical_reasoning: Poison on an OCP device can traverse management, storage or fabric traffic, so the consumer and service boundary are part of the test, not optional post-checks. TX/RX direction is relative to the mapped port and must be tied to requester/completer roles. Without physical module identity, the identical PCIe tuple cannot prove a separate OCP target or coverage point.
